newsitem.title: USA: CFTC revises Dec 20 T-bond/note, Eurodollar data.
newsitem.headline: CFTC revises Dec 20 T-bond/note, Eurodollar data.

text.p: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission on Monday said it issued revised data for several contracts included in its biweekly Futures Commitments of Traders report issued on December 20.
A CFTC spokeswoman said the revisions covered the commitments data for CBOT T-bonds, 10-year and 5-year Treasury notes and IMM Eurodollars for the latest week ended December 17.
The revisions were tied to a reclassification of some data between the commercial and non-commercial categories, the spokeswoman said. She declined further comment.
The remainder of the report and all data for the report on the week ended December 10 were unchanged.
The data is on pages 1CFTC and 2CFTC.

CFTC on Monday also released its biweekly Futures/Options Commitments of Traders report on pages 3CFTC and 4CFTC. The report incorporates the revisions issued on Monday for the Futures-only report, the spokeswoman said.
